messages:
noah: quick PSA: some customers hit runtime errors importing @redwood/inference-js in Edge. failing stack shows 'Unexpected token export' from a file named index.cjs.
riley: that sounds like a package resolution / build artifact mismatch. which tag?
noah: 2.4.0 (published yesterday). i inspected the tarball via `npm pack`  list: included dist/index.mjs, dist/index.cjs, dist/index.d.ts. no .map files. package.json exports only point to ./dist/index.cjs.
build-bot: CI publish log: `tsup --format cjs,esm --dts --sourcemap`, artifacts emitted include .map files in build workspace, but `.npmignore` contains `*.map` so `npm pack` excluded them.
riley: missing sourcemaps is annoying but the export syntax error suggests the .cjs file still contains ESM `export` syntax. maybe the cjs build target wasn't transpiled.
noah: confirmed: dist/index.cjs begins with `export const createClient =`  looks like we renamed .mjs->.cjs without converting syntax.
qa: filed ticket DEVEX-918. root cause possibilities: tsup config using `format: ['cjs','esm']` but transformer didn't apply for cjs due to a plugin; or a post-build rename step. also `.npmignore` accidentally stripping .map.
riley: quick fixes: 1) remove `*.map` from `.npmignore` and add `dist/*.map` to package.json `files`; 2) update package.json `exports` to dual entry: `{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}`; 3) ensure tsup produces proper cjs transpiled output (set `target` and use `format: 'cjs'` path).
noah: i'll open a patch branch. also want to add a smoke test in publish CI that runs `npm pack` and validates packed files: contains `.map`, both index.mjs and index.cjs, and that index.cjs does not contain regex `^\s*export\s+` (simple check).
release-bot: note: previous publish job used `npm publish --access public` after build, but CI used `--no-git-tag-version` skipping prepare hooks. we'll ensure `npm run prepare` runs before publish.
qa: also add canary dist-tag for 2.4.1-canary once fixed so users can test. update release notes to mention edge and sourcemap fix.
riley: small consumer-facing doc note: include recommended import patterns for ESM/CJS and guidance for edge runtimes in SDK README.
noah: will do the patch, run `npm pack` locally, and paste results here before tagging. assigning DEVEX-918 to me. will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
